title: When Algorithms Infer Gender: Revisiting Computational Phenotyping with Electronic Health Records Data
reasoning: The paper explores the ethical and methodological dimensions of gender-related computational phenotyping, employing frameworks like epistemic and data justice to critique existing practices. While ethical analysis is a core component of the review, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as subject matter; instead, it applies these concepts to evaluate algorithmic validity and utility.
